{{Quote|The Resistance is dead. The Sith flame will burn. All worlds, surrender or die. The Final Order begins.|[[Beaumont Kin]] translates Darth Sidious' [[ur-Kittât]]|<ref name="Episode IX" />}}
The '''''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer''', also known as the '''''Xyston''-class Destroyer''', the '''Final Order Star Destroyer''', the '''Sith Star Destroyer''', '''Sith Destroyer''', or simply the "'''planet destroyer'''," was a model of [[Star Destroyer]] exclusively used by the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]]. Manufactured by [[Kuat-Entralla Engineering]] and essentially derived from the traditional [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], the ''Xyston''-class was one of a kind due to its [[axial superlaser]] capable of annihilating any world or ship. The Sith Star Destroyer represented the culmination of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]]' vision of a galaxy forced into submission by sheer military might and intimidation. 

Patiently built in utmost secrecy on [[Exegol]] at Sidious' behest during and well after the [[Galactic Civil War]], the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer would prove to be the most powerful ship ever made in galactic history, as a single destroyer would pose a deadly threat to virtually any world or vessel. Although the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer successfully [[Destruction of Kijimi|raided]] and obliterated the planet [[Kijimi]], it would not see action until the climactic [[Battle of Exegol]] in [[35 ABY]], where the thousand strong fleet of Sith Star Destroyers faced overwhelming odds. 

Darth Sidious ordered [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] to deploy the fleet of ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers from Exegol, but their launch was prevented ''in extremis'' by the destruction of the Sith fleet's [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|flagship]]. Trapped in Exegol's atmosphere and unable to move from their position, the Sith Star Destroyers were ultimately destroyed one after the other at great cost by the Resistance. Not only their destruction potentially saved many worlds and deprived the [[First Order]] of decisive reinforcements, it also sealed the collapse of the Final Order and with it, marked the turning point of the [[First Order-Resistance War|ongoing war]] in favor of the Resistance.

Unparalleled and well ahead of its time, the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer was a redoutable battleship that could and should have been the ultimate weapon guaranteeing the domination of the [[Sith Eternal]] upon the galaxy. But [[Axial superlaser|critical flaws]] in its conception prematurely sealed its fate before the Sith Star Destroyer could unleash its full potential. Ultimately, the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer was abandoned and disbanded following the death of Darth Sidious and the subsequent destruction of its representatives at the [[Battle of Exegol]]. 

==Characteristics==
===Design===
{{Quote|A fleet of ''Star Destroyers'' a ''thousand'' times more ''powerful'' than the galaxy has ever seen.|Darth Sidious|<ref name="Darth Vader 11">[[Darth Vader (2020) 11|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 11]]</ref>}}
[[File:Xyston-classStarDestroyer.png|left|thumb|255px|The ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer was armed with a powerful superlaser, and was inspired by the design of the ''Imperial I''-class.]]
The ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer, also designated as the ''Xyston''-class Destroyer and known as the Final Order Star Destroyer,<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" /> the Sith Star Destroyer,<ref name="FO Ships" /> Sith Destroyer,<ref name="Ships and Vehicles 4">{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|4|Starships and Vehicles}}</ref> and "planet destroyer,"<ref name="FO Ships" /> was a class of 2,406-[[meter]]-long and 682-meter-high [[Star Destroyer]] that was manufactured by [[Kuat-Entralla Engineering]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Due to its length, it fell under the [[battlecruiser]] classification in the [[Anaxes War College System]].<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" /> It was also considered a [[battleship]], however.<ref name="Launchpad230" /> The [[starship]] was meant to invoke annihilation.<ref name="POV 220">{{InsiderCite|220|A Certain Point of View (department)}}</ref>

Since their construction was undertaken at the time of the Galactic Empire, their design was therefore strongly reminiscent of the historic [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], and appeared to be quite outdated by the time the Sith Star Destroyers were finally revealed to the galaxy in 35 ABY. On the other hand, they were scaled up and fitted with efficient automation systems to lower crew requirements to 29,585 crew members. Each ''Xyston'' featured the red markings of the [[Sith Eternal]] on the very edges of its dorsal hull. As a derivative of the ''Imperial''-class design, the Sith Star Destroyer maintained the same dagger-shaped [[hull]], and was characterized by a [[conning tower]] situated atop a [[armor]]ed superstructure.<ref name="TROS VD" />

===Equipment and systems===
[[File:SithStarDestroyerProduction-2020DarthVader11.png|thumb|right|285px|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers under construction during the Imperial Era]]
Within the tower were the inhabited crew decks, the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], and<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" /> a powerful<ref name="Exegol">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Final Order and the Battle of Exegol}}</ref> [[deflector shield generator]]. The tower's exterior featured two [[deflector shield generator dome]]s on the port and starboard side, with an enhanced [[communications array]] identical in physical appearance<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" /> to the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer's]] [[tractor beam targeting array]] situated at the center.<ref name="Droids">''[[Droids in Distress (book)|Droids in Distress]]''</ref> The bow of the Sith Star Destroyer was stocked with a forward [[sensor]] cluster, forward atmosphere pressurization and circulation pumps, the atmosphere distribution duct, raw material stores, and liquid stores.<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" />

Although equipped with a [[hyperdrive]] and [[deflector shield]]s, Sith Star Destroyers could not activate either on [[Exegol]] due to the turbulent [[atmosphere]] full of static discharges.<ref name="FO Ships" /> While they possessed individual [[Navigation computer|navigation systems]],<ref name="Exegol" /> a [[navigational beacon]] from a [[navigation tower]] had to be connected to the navigation systems on each ''Xyston''-class ship, surrendering their flight control systems to a coordinating [[Artificial intelligence|intelligence]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

===Reactor and superlaser===
{{Main|Axial superlaser}}
{{Quote|These— these aren't just ''machines''. Each will carry a ''cannon''… that can ''destroy'' a ''planet''… and there are ''hundreds'' of them!|[[Ochi]]|<ref name="Darth Vader 11" />}}
[[File:Axial_superlaser.png|thumb|left|250px|The axial superlaser of a ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]]
The epitome of the destroyer's destructive nature,<ref name="POV 220" /> ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers were each equipped with the axial superlaser cannon, a [[superweapon]] capable of destroying entire planets<ref name="TROS VD" /> in the name of enforcing Darth Sidious' rule.<ref name="POV 220" /> The weapon was activated by the direct impulse of ionic energy from the reactor<ref name="Exegol" /> and when fired, the axial superlaser fired a continuous blast that penetrated deep into a planet. After penetrating the surface, the beam pulsated continuously<ref name="Episode IX" /> generated by its reactor<ref name="FO Ships" /> until parts of a planet exploded, eventually resulting in the entire terrestrial body succumbing to a large explosion.<ref name="Episode IX" /> The barrel of axial superlaser had a forcing cone barrel head followed by a collimator assembly sleeve. The cannon was supported by articulation cradle [[servomotor]]s and a superlaser power feed direct from the main reactor. Like the [[Death Star]]<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" /> and [[Starkiller Base]],<ref name="POV230">{{InsiderCite|230|A Certain Point of View}}</ref> these weapons were powered by [[kyber crystal]]s,<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" /> which also served to boost the weapon's power. Inside the warship, the kyber crystals were also exposed to dark energies, which may have [[Bleeding|played a role]] in making the blasts a vibrant red.<ref name="POV230" /> Hangar space and deep storage areas were sacrificed to make space for the axial superlaser and its related power distribution network.<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" />

The [[First Order]]'s [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] was a test project that was derived from the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer's design.<ref name="TROS VD" /> Since the superlaser was tied to the ship's reactor, the destruction of one led to the destruction of both.<ref name="Battles">{{DK|url=uk/book/9780241418703-star-wars-battles-that-changed-the-galaxy|text=Star Wars Battles That Changed the Galaxy}}</ref> The abundant reserves of power had to be diligently balanced and managed by a crew of skilled [[fleet technician]]s. Usually, ship systems brought down the power output to safe levels, but since the superlaser was a direct tap to the reactor, any miscalculation committed by technical crews monitoring the reactor would have critical consequences. Bridge-based duty stations were more desirable posts for fleet technicians than the [[Radiation|radioactive]] areas of the engineering section or superlaser maintenance.<ref name="TROS VD" /> The reactor was located near the primary [[power converter]]s, a principal power distribution trunk, a port main [[sublight engine]] power trunk, reactor coolant pumps, and a heavy weapons power converter. Located within the superstructure were the hyperdrive generator and field projectors, the hyperdrive power distribution trunk, and an atmospheric processing plant. Towards the stern of the ship, the main sublight engine nozzles gave way to the coolant storage bottles, the main reactor [[fuel]] silo, the auxiliary reactor, and other systems.<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" />

[[File:Xyston-engines.png|thumb|right|285px|The rear of the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]]
For sublight propulsion, the ''Xyston''-class featured seven [[ion engine]]s (three primary and four secondary, with the smaller secondary engines flanking the larger main engines) at the aft of the vessel,<ref name="Episode IX" /> and main power was provided by a [[solar ionization reactor]] that fed directly into the Sith Star Destroyer's planet-destroying [[axial superlaser]]. At least two [[Hangar|launch bays]] were adjacent to the [[superlaser]], and an [[engineer]]ing section was located between the [[cannon]] and the [[reactor]]. The reactor was situated on the ventral hull below the superstructure of the Star Destroyer. The reactor consisted of a [[hypermatter]] annihilation chamber that was protected by a multi-layered [[armor]] and shielded dome.<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" /> The heavily shielded [[carbonite]]- and [[durasteel]]-lined chamber collected the energy output from the power core, and distributed to intensive systems like the hyperdrive and the sublight propulsion.<ref name="TROS VD" /> With the injection of hypermatter catalysts, the reactor created a miniature [[Star|sun]], and the resulting energetic output was channeled directly into the [[Kyber crystal|kyber]]-focused superlaser.<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" />

===Other armament and complement===
The sole purpose of the ''Xyston''-class was to enforce Darth Sidious' rule with their superlasers, creating a ship that exemplified the idea that form followed function.<ref name="POV 220" /> All the same, for ship-to-ship combat and defense,<ref name="Episode IX" /> ''Xyston''-class ships were further armed with forty heavy [[turbolaser]] batteries, forty [[ion cannon]]s, forty [[point-defense laser cannon]]s, thirty-five [[variable-ordnance warhead launcher]]s, and ten heavy [[tractor beam projector]]s. The two launch bays contained a total of seventy-two [[TIE/dg starfighter]]s<ref name="TROS VD" /> that were held in place by docking clamps.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Role==
{{Quote|The day this fleet launches, freedom dies in the galaxy.|[[Beaumont Kin]]|<ref name="Episode IX" />}}
The ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer was meant to quickly station itself at various key points throughout [[the galaxy]] with the aim of removing any desire for freedom and establishing an everlasting order.<ref name="FO Ships" /> With its [[orbital bombardment]] role, the ''Xyston'' could be used for first-strike capabilities.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==History==
===Creation and early history===
{{Quote|The might of the Final Order will soon be ready. It will be yours if you do as I ask.|Darth Sidious, to Kylo Ren|<ref name="Episode IX" />}}
[[File:SithStarDestroyersBeingConstructed-2020DarthVader11.png|thumb|left|360px|The ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers were under construction since the time of the Galactic Empire within the shipyards of Exegol.]]
Shortly after the rise to power of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]], the [[Sith Lord]] began to modernize the [[Shipyards of Exegol|shipyard forges]] in the [[Forbidden District]] on the [[Sith]] world of [[Exegol]] in the [[Unknown Regions]] as a contingency to maintain a redoubt of power secret from the rest of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Secret shipments from corporate Sith loyalists updated the facilities to produce the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer and the new Sith [[TIE/dg starfighter]]s.<ref name="Complete Vehicles NE" /> By the [[time]] of the [[Escape from Cloud City]] by members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Darth Vader 11" /> in [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> hundreds of Sith Star Destroyers were already in production below the surface of Exegol by [[Sith cultist]]s. When Sidious' [[Sith apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and the [[Sith assassin]] [[Ochi|Ochi of Bestoon]] arrived during a [[mission to Exegol]] in order for Vader to uncover his [[Sith Master]]'s secrets and challenge his power, the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] revealed the Sith armada of Star Destroyers to further display his power to Vader. Sidious additionally revealed a large kyber crystal near the [[shipyard]] that was used for the superlasers and bled it, resulting in a blinding light and Vader's submission to Sidious.<ref name="Darth Vader 11" />

Following the first [[death]] of Sidious during the [[Battle of Endor]], the death of Vader,<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> and the subsequent collapse of the Empire,<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref> Darth Sidious returned and controlled the rise of the [[First Order]], a successor state ruled by his puppet [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]]. The First Order deployed the ''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought,<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> which was in actuality a test project for the axial superlasers for the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers.<ref name="TROS VD" /> Following the usurpation of Snoke's apprentice, [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], to the position of Supreme Leader and [[First Order-Resistance War|continued war]] between the First Order and the [[Resistance]], Darth Sidious announced his return to the wider galaxy. When Ren confronted Sidious on Exegol, the Sith Lord raised the entire Sith armada, named the [[Final Order]],<ref name="Episode IX" /> and tens of thousands of Sith Star Destroyers<ref name="TROS EE" /> from beneath the planet's surface. The Sith [[fleet]] was offered to Ren to bolster the First Order's resources and to rule the galaxy under the perpetual reign of a new [[Sith Empire]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

The news of the legions of Sith Star Destroyers was discussed by the [[First Order Supreme Council]], where it was debated by the top leaders of the regime. After the Supreme Leader stated his belief that the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] would allow the First Order to develop into a true empire, General [[Domaric Quinn]] expressed distrust in the newly discovered Sith armada. [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] quickly rebutted and scolded Quinn by stating that the Final Order fleet would increase the First Order's resources ten-thousandfold and that it would correct the error of [[Starkiller Base]]. As a result of the Sith armada, General [[Bellava Parnadee]] suggested to General [[Amret Engell]] that the First Order should increase recruitments, yet Quinn was then killed by Supreme Leader Kylo Ren after again expressing skepticism.<ref name="Episode IX" />

===Destruction of Kijimi===
{{Quote|Send a ship to a world they know. Let it burn. The Final Order begins.|Darth Sidious, to Allegiant General Enric Pryde|<ref name="Episode IX" />}}
[[File:Derriphan_TROS.png|thumb|right|275px|The ''Derriphan'' prepares to open fire on Kijimi.]]
Following a [[Mission to Kef Bir|duel]] on [[Kef Bir]] and Ren's subsequent return to the [[light side of the Force]] and reclaiming his old identity as Ben Solo, Sidious contacted Allegiant General Pryde to dispatch a ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer to [[Kijimi]] to destroy it as a show of the Sith Eternal's power and for the general to travel to Exegol after ordering him to Exegol to oversee the launch of the Final Order and lead it. Pledging his loyalty once again to his [[Galactic Emperor]], General Pryde carried out the orders.<ref name="Episode IX" />

The Sith Star Destroyer ''[[Derriphan]]'', under the command of [[Captain]] [[Chesille Sabrond]], was then sent out from Exegol to the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] world, becoming the first ''Xyston''-class ship to launch into the galaxy at large. Once First Order [[Kijimi garrison|forces]] had been evacuated with [[Protocol 13]],<ref name="TROS VD" /> the ''Derriphan'' fired its axial superlaser and [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] Kijimi.<ref name="Episode IX" /> Following the destruction of the planet, the ''Derriphan'' returned to Exegol and rejoined the Sith fleet, notifying [[Imperial Command (Final Order)|Imperial Command]] to its success.<ref name="TROS EE">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]''</ref>

===Battle of Exegol===
====Prelude and first attack====
After the Resistance regrouped on [[Ajan Kloss]], they discovered that their companion Rey had taken [[Luke Skywalker]]'s [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|T-65B X-wing]] [[Red Five (T-65B X-wing starfighter)|''Red Five'']] to Exegol, and was transmitting navigation coordinates that led the way through the Unknown Regions. General [[Poe Dameron]] and General [[Finn]] rallied the Resistance, and proposed that if they destroyed the navigation tower on Exegol's surface, the Sith fleet would be stuck in the atmosphere and without shields. Once that occurred, they would target the axial superlasers on the Sith Star Destroyers and destroy the fleet. Knowing that they were outnumbered, General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] were sent on the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' through the [[Core Worlds]] to rally any allies. Soon after the briefing, Rey had arrived on Exegol, which was announced by a [[Sith Eternal officer]] on a Sith Star Destroyer. Allegiant General Pryde promptly ordered the fleet to rise to deployment altitude, and the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers began to rise through the surface.<ref name="Episode IX" />

Shortly after Rey entered the [[Sith Citadel]], a [[Unidentified Sith Eternal fleet technician|Sith fleet technician]] on the ''Derriphan'' announced to Captain Sabrond that they had Resistance craft incoming. Sabrond looked to General Pryde for direction, who then ordered her to use ion cannons. The [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]] then arrived on Exegol, and immediately came under attack by the legions of Sith Star Destroyers. After the chaotic entry, General Dameron ordered the Resistance ships to drop to the fleet's altitude, deducing that the Star Destroyers could not fire on them without inflicting damage on themselves. Finn then located the navigation tower, but the Sith Star Destroyers launched swarms of Sith TIE fighters from their launch bays and engaged the Resistance fighters. Once the Resistance began approaching the tower, General Pryde ordered that the signal be transferred to his [[flagship]], the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']].<ref name="Episode IX" />

====Battle intensifies====
[[File:Xyston-butt-is-gone.png|thumb|left|260px|Defenseless against the allied attack, many Sith Star Destroyers quickly succumbed to multiple explosions.]]
Once the signal was switched to the ''Steadfast'', the Resistance attack pivoted to the Sith fleet's [[command ship]], and landed [[Resistance trooper]]s on the hull near the ship's navigation tower while they were provided air cover by the starfighters. After a skirmish on the ''Steadfast'', the Resistance managed to temporarily disable the navigation system. They soon realized that the ''Steadfast'' was rebooting their system, and that reinforcements may not be arriving. Dameron then ordered aerial Resistance forces to attack the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers themselves, but began sustaining major casualties. Rey looked on while she confronted Darth Sidious at the Citadel as more Resistance fighters were destroyed by the Sith forces. [[Temmin Wexley's X-wing|One starfighter]], piloted by [[Major]] [[Temmin Wexley]], was shot down and crashed into the hull of a Sith Star Destroyer, causing an explosion. Overwhelmed by the communications and visuals of his companions being destroyed around him, Dameron apologized to his pilots and began to lose hope.<ref name="Episode IX" />

It was at that moment that General Calrissian and Chewbacca had arrived, with a sizable force of 14,000 vessels that was dubbed the [[Citizens' Fleet]]. Dameron promptly took command and ordered the ships to target the superlasers on the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers.<ref name="Episode IX" /> The Sith Star Destroyer ''[[Sutta]]'', under the command of [[Captain]] [[Strok]], became the first victim of the allied forces, with starfighters and the ''Millennium Falcon'' targeting the ''Sutta''{{'s}} superlaser. The cannon exploded, and sent a chain reaction through the midship that caused multiple large explosions that consumed the Star Destroyer.<ref name="Battles" /> Shortly after the ''Sutta''{{'s}} destruction was relayed on the ''Steadfast''{{'s}} bridge, General Pryde expressed confusion on where the Resistance could have conjured up such a force. The [[Smuggler|spice runner]] [[Zorii Bliss]] within a [[BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter]] then targeted another Xyston's superlaser and destroyed it, resulting in multiple explosions on the Sith Star Destroyer's ventral hull.<ref name="Episode IX" />

[[File:Xyston-Exegol-2.png|thumb|right|260px|The Final Order fleet was overwhelmed.]]
The allied armada had soon followed the initial assault, and began pelting the Sith fleet with [[laser]]fire, [[concussion missile]]s, and [[proton torpedo]]es. The Resistance no longer had a numerical disadvantage, and the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers crumpled under the attack as they were too close to each other. As a result, many Sith Star Destroyers collided, others lost their engines and began falling to Exegol's surface. The large vessels that were designed to destroy planets could not destroy the smaller vessels of the Resistance.<ref name="TROS JN">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> One Sith Star Destroyer listed sideways with smoke billowing from its hull and collided with another, and both fell to the surface. Another Star Destroyer fell after a pair of torpedoes hit its underside.<ref name="TROS EE" /> Star Destroyers began falling out of their place in the fleet, with many exploding into multiple segments.<ref name="Episode IX" />

====Counterattack and final destruction====
[[File:Wreckage-on-Exegol.png|thumb|left|280px|The surface of Exegol was riddled with the wrecks of the Sith Star Destroyers.]]
Concurrent to the battle, Rey and the redeemed Ben Solo were incapacitated after they had confronted Sidious and the [[Living Force|live Force]] of their [[Force dyad]] was consumed. Regaining his body and obtaining untapped power, Sidious exclaimed to his Sith disciples not to worry about the allied attack on the Final Order fleet. Sidious then released a torment of [[Force lightning]] into the atmosphere, targeting any vessels that were not affiliated with the Sith. The ships were disabled and began to crash down into the surface, but Rey, who had summoned the strength from all the Jedi before her once again confronted Sidious, forcing him to end the lightning barrage. Recuperating, the allied forces regrouped and continued their attack on the Sith Star Destroyers.<ref name="Episode IX" />

Darth Sidious was soon killed by Rey, and the bridge of the ''Steadfast'' was destroyed by Finn and Resistance fighter [[Jannah]], resulting in the loss of the navigation signal. As Sith Star Destroyers crumbled all around the ''Steadfast'', the ship began to fall and crashed into the surface of Exegol after Finn and Jannah were rescued. Many other Sith Star Destroyers began crashing into the surface, and wreckage soon littered much of the ground. As Star Destroyers continued to crash, Rey in ''Red Five'' joined with the Resistance forces and the Citizens' Fleet, which were beginning to leave the planet. As word of the Sith Eternal's defeat and the destruction of the Sith spread, an [[uprising against the First Order]] began throughout the galaxy.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Xyston-class_Cross-section.png|thumb|right|250px|Cross-sections of the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer.]]
The ''Xyston''-class first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Episode IX" /> The concept of a modified [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] equipped with a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] exists in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity as the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']].<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Conqueror}}</ref>
